prompt_en:
Generate a completely new photorealistic scene; Image 1 is appearance guidance only for the visible adult captain. At storm-bright dawn, stage a biaoju guarded cargo departure from loading yard to road, a biaoju guarded-cargo departure centered on a mule cart. The unmistakably adult escort captain at the near flank has long near-black wavy hair with a center part, a softly oval face, warm brown eyes, straight brows, and natural closed lips. Keep her face readable within the wide convoy.

In one elevated diagonal view, one loading yard or bureau gate opens directly onto the departure road in one continuous view. Three astronomical crates make sealed boxes or bundled cargo visibly load one cart pack animal or coherent transport unit beneath taut rope restraints; show wax seals. Adult martial escorts occupy front rear and flank positions around the same owned cargo with weapons ready: one scout beneath the gate, one rear guard in the yard, and two beside opposite wheels. Wheels hooves handles and body orientations continue from yard through gate onto one readable road under shared forward movement. Wheel tracks and hoofprints continue from the loading yard, through the gate, and onto the winding desert road. These relations ensure the scene remains a commercial armed cargo escort rather than an army convoy merchant-only caravan adventuring party empty courtyard or generic wagon through visible ownership and protection.

Use a 28 mm elevated three-quarter camera. Warm sunrise catches a thunderhead; cool storm light shapes dusty stone. Show grounded wheel, hoof, and foot contact, wind-driven fabric, and photoreal wood, rope, hide, dust, and metal.
